scope: Two-file proposal reviewed and integrated with corrections; no delegated commands or tests
accepted: Optional persisted physical main SQLite ceiling and legacy two-key header support
Verified page limit on create and each open
Typed SQLITE_FULL preserving original error through automatic rollback
corrections: Original rollback formula missed sector/header spill overhead. Main spilling is now explicitly disabled and checked; rollback budget includes per-page eight-byte records and 128KiB sector allowance
Derived bill lookups use a separate capped64MiB in-memory SQLite database, so full graph validation does not dirty a large main-catalog transaction
Retain filtered SQL identity iteration and one-statement bounded projections instead of loading every body for every kind
Handle removal of an actual hot journal during SQLite recovery; the pre-open directory listing cannot prove it still exists
Round defaults to pages; explicit ceilings are page-aligned; 64GiB generic main maximum covers older declared16GiB/1m limits without clamping the derived formula
Add actual killed-writer recovery and pass host physical ceiling into archive decode
limits: No global quota/HTTP/UI proof. Helper budget applies only to catalog connections with spilling disabled, not prepared or builder stores.64MiB derived lookup cap may refuse an over-capacity graph without creating a partial backup.
